*   **Procedure Code:** CPT 63030
*   **Requesting Surgeon:** Dr. Okafor, MD, Orthopedic Surgery

Dear Appeals Review Committee,

I am writing to formally appeal the denial of prior authorization for my lower back disc surgery / decompression (CPT 63030), which is scheduled to be performed by Dr. Okafor. Cigna's denial letter dated 2026-07-31 stated that the procedure "does not meet the plan's criteria for medical necessity." 

This determination is clinically incorrect. My medical records demonstrate that I meet every medical necessity requirement outlined in the plan's governing clinical guideline, **"Cigna Medical Coverage Policies – Musculoskeletal: Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy, Laminectomy, or Hemilaminectomy)" (Policy Number: CMM-606, Effective July 1, 2025)**. 

Specifically, my clinical presentation satisfies all criteria under section **"CMM-606.2: Initial Primary Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy, Laminectomy or Hemilaminectomy)"** for **"Radiculopathy"**. Below is a direct mapping of the policy's criteria to my clinical documentation:

### 1. Subjective Symptoms
*   **Policy Requirement:** *"Subjective symptoms include BOTH of the following: Significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.) [and] Persistent radiating pain into the buttock(s) and/or lower extremity(ies)"*
*   **Patient Clinical Record:** 
    *   I suffer from severe, progressive lower back pain and radicular pain radiating directly into my right calf, which has persisted for 14 months.
    *   This pain causes severe, daily functional impairment: I am completely unable to stand for more than 10 minutes at a time.

### 2. Objective Physical Exam Findings
*   **Policy Requirement:** *"Objective physical exam findings include EITHER of the following: Nerve root tension sign including ANY of the following: Positive straight leg raise, Crossed straight leg raise, Femoral stretch test [or] Neurologic deficit including ANY of the following: Dermatomal sensory deficit, Functionally limiting motor weakness (e.g., foot drop, quadriceps weakness), Reflex changes"*
*   **Patient Clinical Record:** 
    *   Physical examination by Dr. Okafor notes positive provocative testing (nerve root tension sign/straight leg raise) on the affected right side.
    *   Physical examination confirms a neurologic deficit corresponding directly to the imaged L4-L5 level.

### 3. Conservative Management
*   **Policy Requirement:** *"Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): Prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or NSAIDs for six (6) weeks; Provider-directed exercise program prescribed by a physical therapist... for six (6) weeks; Epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s)..."*
*   **Patient Clinical Record:** I have exhausted all three conservative care modalities without meaningful, lasting relief:
    1.  **Medications:** I have been taking NSAIDs for 6 months with inadequate pain relief.
    2.  **Physical Therapy:** I completed 12 weeks of supervised, provider-directed physical therapy (comprising core stabilization and lumbar flexibility) from 2026-04-10 to 2026-07-03, spanning 16 total visits. This is fully documented in my physical therapy discharge note.
    3.  **Injections:** I underwent a corticosteroid injection (CSI) on 2026-04-20, which yielded only 2 weeks of partial relief before my severe pain returned.

### 4. Advanced Imaging Findings
*   **Policy Requirement:** *"MRI/CT shows neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that is concordant with the individual’s symptoms and physical exam findings and that is caused by ANY of the following: Herniated disc(s) (retained disc material or a recurrent disc herniation)... Central/lateral/foraminal stenosis..."*
*   **Patient Clinical Record:** My lumbar spine MRI dated 2026-06-08 reveals an L4-L5 disc extrusion (herniation) with severe right lateral recess stenosis and severe compression of the traversing L5 nerve root. This structure compression is perfectly concordant with my right calf radicular pain and my L5 neurologic deficit.

### 5. Absence of Exclusions/Behavioral Health Complications
*   **Policy Requirement:** *"Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)"*
*   **Patient Clinical Record:** I have no untreated substance use or unmanaged behavioral health disorders. Furthermore, I have a healthy BMI of 29, am a non-smoker, and have no active infections.

### Conclusion
My condition has failed to improve despite more than a year of comprehensive conservative treatment. The severe compression of my L5 nerve root requires immediate surgical decompression to prevent permanent neurological damage and restore my basic functional capacity. Because my clinical records exhaustively satisfy every criterion set forth in **Cigna Policy CMM-606.2**, the requested procedure is indisputably medically necessary.

Please reverse this denial and approve the prior authorization for CPT 63030. I have attached the following supporting documents for your immediate review:
1.  Office visit notes from Dr. Okafor, MD.
2.  Lumbar spine MRI report dated 2026-06-08.
3.  Supervised Physical Therapy Discharge Note (16 visits, 2026-04-10 to 2026-07-03).
4.  Records of the corticosteroid injection administered on 2026-04-20.

If you require any further information, please contact me immediately at [Patient Phone Number] or contact Dr. Okafor's office at [Physician Phone Number].

Sincerely,

Taylor Jennings
